summary: Applied Owner amendment A0004 at the SPEC layer to exactly the two PLANNED contracts T060 and T086, plus docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, docs/spec/security/THREAT_MODEL.md and spec_revision; no other file changed. (1) WEB_CONSOLE.md section 4: the position-chart bullet is now conditional - it always shows liquidity and the raw token0/token1 quantities, shows the dataset's reporting-numeraire equivalent when the dataset is QUALIFIED, and shows the relative form with an explicit RELATIVE_ONLY marker when it is not; the pre-existing prohibition on labelling liquidityDelta as USDG is retained verbatim, every other bullet of section 4 is byte-identical, and sections 5 and 6 are untouched. (2) THREAT_MODEL.md: five new rows in the document's existing shape (severity, scenario, controls in V1, owner, residual risk, evidence) - T-17 label leakage or look-ahead in the research panel, T-18 a RELATIVE_ONLY artifact read or reported as USD-denominated, T-19 a research artifact or model acquiring execution authority, T-20 model output bypassing or weakening the central risk gateway, T-21 a published dataset version, numeraire or split boundary mutated - each naming existing controls and existing owners (T-17: T050/T064/T101 with DS-020-DS-022; T-18: T052/T053/T084/T086/T103 with ADR-014 clause 3 and WEB-GLOBAL-001; T-19: T070/T085/T086/T094/T102/T103 with ADR-014 clauses 1 and 5 and G-ML-01; T-20: T060/T070/T102 with G-RISK-01 and ADR-006; T-21: T031/T032/T063/T100/T101/T103 with DS-002 and DS-043). The section 4 severity rubric's Examples column and the section 5 controls matrix were extended with exactly those rows so the document's own indexes stay complete; no existing threat row was restated or weakened and the trust boundaries, section 6 and section 7 are unchanged. (3) T086: Deliverables gain research-surface journeys (no research page reachable from, or confusable with, an execution-shaped control; a saved dataset or model definition cannot be read as, offered as, or promoted to an execution approval; the four T103-owned pages carry their own journeys and are explicitly not re-scripted here) and per-journey RELATIVE_ONLY distinguishability; Acceptance gains the two matching clauses; References now cite ADR-014, T085 and T103; Dependencies stay T083, T085. (4) T060: a new section before Outcome fixes the vocabulary - RegimeModel and FeeOpportunityModel are the component names taken from STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7, RegimeAssessment and the fee-opportunity assessment are their output names - records the regime and fee-opportunity components as the sole supported extension point for a trained model, requires a model-backed implementation to satisfy the same contract as a rule implementation (same versioned point-in-time inputs, output names, shapes and units, same validation and determinism duties), forbids it from altering the admission/market/portfolio snapshots, the candidate action, the ledger, risk or audit semantics, and requires each interface to be able to signal uncertainty and refuse to produce an assessment rather than force one; Deliverables name the components beside their outputs, one acceptance clause was appended (no existing acceptance clause changed), Must not was extended, and References now cite ADR-014 clause 5 and STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7. (5) spec_revision raised from v1-2026-09-19-numeraire-web-console to v1-2026-09-19-research-threats-and-strategy-extension. Constraints held: the changed path set is exactly those five files; docs/intent/ and every accepted ADR are cited, never edited; T022, T023 and T038 appear in no added line; no task status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum, dependency field or agent-runtime setting changed (both targets remain PLANNED at attempt 0 and their identity blocks are byte-identical); and no URL, API key, authorization header or environment value was written.
rationale: Owner-direction mapping, item by item. Item 1 (WEB_CONSOLE.md section 4): the clause was made conditional exactly as directed - raw quantities unconditional, reporting-numeraire equivalent under QUALIFIED, relative form plus an explicit RELATIVE_ONLY marker otherwise - which removes the contradiction with WEB-GLOBAL-001's rule that a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset carries no USD-denominated field anywhere, including in the position chart; the USDG-labelling prohibition was carried over untouched and no other bullet was edited, so nothing in section 4 was weakened and sections 5 and 6 were not touched. Reporting-numeraire equivalent is used rather than USDG equivalent because the amended WEB-GLOBAL-001 admits USDG, a qualified USD stablecoin, or ETH labelled as a volatile display, and an ETH display must not read as a dollar figure. Item 2 (THREAT_MODEL.md): the five directed risks became rows T-17 to T-21 in the document's own field order, each with a severity and an owner as that document's update procedure requires, and each control cites only controls that already exist or are already contracted instead of inventing new ones: DS-020 to DS-022 with T050/T064/T101 for the purge/embargo and point-in-time discipline the direction named; ADR-014 clause 3, DS-003, WEB-GLOBAL-001 and T052/T053/T084/T086/T103 for the RELATIVE_ONLY misreading; ADR-014 clauses 1 and 5, G-ML-01, T085/T086/T103 and the T070/T094 execution gate with T102 for execution authority; G-RISK-01 with T070 and the T060/T102 component contracts plus ADR-006 for the gateway bypass; ADR-014 clause 4, DS-002, DS-043 with T031/T032/T063/T100/T101/T103 for post-publication mutation. No new control was invented and no obligation was placed on a task that does not already carry it, which matters because only the two named contracts may be edited here, so a control no task owned would have been unusable. The section 4 rubric's Examples column and the section 5 controls matrix are the document's own indexes of its threat rows; both were extended with exactly the new rows so that no threat can be found in section 3 and missing from the matrix, and no severity definition, existing example, trust boundary or section was changed. Severities were assigned from the rubric's own definitions: Critical for a leak that produces undetectably false skill (T-17), for unauthorized execution authority (T-19) and for a risk-gateway bypass (T-20); High for a RELATIVE_ONLY artifact read as a dollar result (T-18), a wrong operator action that the qualification record makes detectable; Medium for post-publication mutation (T-21), which is detectable and recoverable through the manifest and checksum discipline. Item 3 (the two contracts): T086's journey list and Acceptance now carry the research-surface reachability, non-confusability and RELATIVE_ONLY-distinguishability requirements and state explicitly that the four T103-owned pages carry their own journeys, so no journey is duplicated and no page owned by T103 is re-scripted; T060 records the extension point, the same-contract requirement, the prohibition on altering the snapshots, candidate action, ledger, risk or audit semantics, and the uncertainty/refusal requirement, and resolves the naming question the direction raised by stating which names denote components and which denote outputs, written as a mapping from STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7's component list to the contract's output names. Those output names were not invented: RegimeAssessment is pre-existing contract text and the fee-opportunity assessment is the existing phrase in the same Deliverables line. The recorded constraint that only WEB_CONSOLE.md and THREAT_MODEL.md of docs/spec/ may change meant the alignment had to be stated in the contract rather than by adding the output names to STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7, which is cited and left unchanged. No existing acceptance clause was altered in either contract: T060's new clause is appended after the existing ones and T086's existing clauses are byte-identical. Item 4: spec_revision was raised to a new, distinct value. Item 5: the constraints were verified - git diff --stat shows exactly the five allowed paths, the config diff is exactly the spec_revision line, git diff --check is clean, both contracts keep their identity, status, attempt, dependency and reference-to-dependency fields unchanged, and the added text contains no URL, credential, API key, authorization header, address or environment value and cites the superseded T022, T023 or T038 nowhere. Verification performed (investigation only, not acceptance evidence): python -m tools.workflow validate returns OK; tests/test_workflow.py, tests/test_no_signing_paths.py and tests/test_hook_pack_t043.py pass 105/105; the full suite reports 1144 passed, 6 skipped and one failure, test_abi_artifacts::test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output, caused solely by tools/oracle/lib existing only in the main checkout and not in this worktree, a pre-existing host condition unrelated to a documents-only change.
unresolved_questions: STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 7 enumerates the replaceable components but not their outputs, and the output names (RegimeAssessment and the fee-opportunity assessment) are now fixed only in the T060 contract. If the Owner wants the specification's section 7 to list the outputs too, that is a further SPEC edit: this amendment's recorded constraints allow changes to WEB_CONSOLE.md, THREAT_MODEL.md, the two named contracts and spec_revision only, so STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md was cited and left unchanged.

T086's research-surface journey covers the research surfaces the P08 tasks deliver - the console shell and the versioned research-definition write path - while the direction forbids re-scripting the four T103-owned pages, which keep their own reachability and non-mutation validation in T103. End-to-end coverage of all eleven console pages is therefore deliberately split across T086 and T103 rather than held in one journey set.

The five new threat rows were assigned severities by the planner from the document's own rubric (T-17, T-19 and T-20 Critical; T-18 High; T-21 Medium), because the direction required a severity per row and supplied none. A later severity change is permitted by that document's update procedure but requires an explicit note, and it would be a further SPEC edit.
